resources.string: A cleaner, more complete Bilibili interface
This Xposed Module is made by YukiHookAPI. \nLearn more https://github.com/HighCapable/YuKiHookAPI
This Xposed Module is powered by KavaRef.\nLearn more https://github.com/HighCapable/KavaRef
Choose the language used by the module interface and its injected UI
After hiding the app icon, the interface may be closed and will no longer be displayed on the launcher. You can find and open the module settings in EdXposed or LSPosed.
Note: Be sure to turn off the \"Force apps to show launcher icons\" feature in LSPosed
When enabled, promo ads that may pop up after pausing some videos are not displayed
Provides higher-version compatibility support for the roaming module; requires restarting Bilibili twice to take effect
Hide game ads inside the \"Video mentioned\" section
Cleans up the \"Video mentioned\" ads under videos with game tags
Cleans up the home banner carousel that BiliRoaming can no longer handle
Hide the top-bar game center entry
Only blocks the game-center menu item; search, scan, and other entries remain available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Keeps search and its click behavior available while clearing only the suggested text. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, portrait videos opened from Home prefer the standard video details page. Other pages are unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
No keywords configured; tap to edit
When enabled, filters the selected Home recommendations while keeping ordinary video recommendations. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Enter Home tab names to hide. Separate multiple names with commas, semicolons, or line breaks; at least one tab is always kept.
Enter keywords for Home components to hide. Separate multiple keywords with commas, semicolons, or line breaks.
Enter bottom-bar names to hide. Separate multiple names with commas, semicolons, or line breaks; at least one entry is always kept.
When enabled, hides the VIP card on the Mine page. Other entries remain available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, keeps the original space after hiding the VIP card to reduce layout movement. “Hide the VIP card” must also be enabled.
Enter menu names to hide. Separate multiple names with commas, semicolons, or line breaks.
Example: Creator Center, Courses, Game Center
No hide rules configured; tap to edit
When enabled, Bilibili client update prompts are no longer shown. This module\'s update checks are unaffected. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides the City tab while keeping the other tabs and their order. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides the Campus tab while keeping the other tabs and their order. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Show the Video tab by default
When enabled, the Dynamic page opens on the Video tab by default. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, play counts, likes, and similar values prefer full numbers instead of abbreviated values. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, the teen-mode prompt page is no longer shown. Teen-mode state and settings remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Clears only Bilibili splash-ad responses without changing ordinary startup data. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides the player’s portrait-feed button while keeping fullscreen and other controls. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, the video details page uses a transparent status bar. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Filter all portrait-feed series and films
Filters only structured content types exposed by the host. The all-series option also covers the movie, documentary, TV, and variety subtypes. Unrecognized items are kept. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, filters the selected recommendations on video details pages while keeping ordinary video recommendations. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Choose the preferred quality when playback starts. This does not unlock paid quality, and unavailable quality is adjusted automatically. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Continue using Bilibili’s automatic quality setting.
Prefer this quality and adjust automatically when it is unavailable.
Removes the comment tab from video details while leaving the introduction and other tabs available. Restart Bilibili to apply.

Adds a “Trace” entry to top-level comments with replies and presents the actual reply relationships in a draggable, navigable workflow view. Data is loaded only while the panel is open. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, comment keywords no longer open search. Comment text and emoji remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides the one-tap posting guide in an empty comment section. The comment tab remains available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides comment polls and side-picking widgets. Normal likes, replies, and comment content remain available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides follow buttons in comments. Other badges, comment content, and interactions remain available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, comment experience feedback and surveys are no longer shown. Comment content and interactions remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides promotions in comment sections. Comment and reply content remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.

When enabled, tapping comment text or its card no longer opens the reply editor. Reply buttons, the input bar, the three-dot menu, and long-press free copy remain available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
No keywords configured; tap to edit
Separate with commas, semicolons, or new lines; up to 64 entries
When enabled, hides comments and replies containing any keyword. Matching ignores case. Restart Bilibili to apply.
When enabled, hides comments and replies below the selected level. Comments are kept when the level cannot be identified. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Retain comments from Lv%1$d and above
When enabled, "UP merchandise" promotions on some video detail pages are no longer shown
Long-press a comment to open a free-copy sheet (the three-dot menu still works)
Long-press the video description to free-copy text
Long-press the description on the video detail page to open the free-copy sheet
Long-press the text below to select and copy
White background with black text — better contrast on light themes
Currently controlled by auto light/dark follow
Bubble color follows Bilibili light/dark theme
This will disable auto light/dark follow. Continue?
When enabled, the module records runtime logs (viewable in LSPosed logs)
Only significant errors and runtime issues
All hook hits and interception details
Confirm to save and restart Bilibili?
Adaptation records cleared. Restart Bilibili to re-adapt automatically.
View source code, releases, and documentation
Check the latest version from the selected channel
Receives stable GitHub Releases only; Alpha pre-releases are ignored.
Receives both stable and Alpha releases and picks the highest version.
Preview versions may contain unverified changes. Switching back to Stable does not downgrade the installed version; wait until a later stable release outranks it.
You already have the latest stable version
You already have the latest preview-channel version
The installed version is newer than the latest stable release; no stable update is available yet
Couldn\'t reach GitHub or the mirror. Stable update check failed
Couldn\'t reach GitHub or the mirror. Preview update check failed
This is a pre-release version and may contain unverified changes.
GitHub is unavailable. Switched to a mirror.
No browser is available to open this link
Export module settings to a local file or preview and restore a backup
Save the current supported settings to a local file you choose.
The file is validated and a compatibility preview is shown before anything is changed.
Automatically restorable: %1$d. Records in the file: %2$d.
Roaming compatibility is recorded only for review and is never changed automatically in this version.
Not included: app language, update channel, launcher icon state, activation/scope state, timestamps, logs, adaptation data, and runtime caches.
SHA-256 detects accidental file damage; it does not prove who created or edited a backup.
Reading, validating, and planning the import…
Applying settings and reconciling derived state…
The old version used its default; the current value is preserved
Added after this backup; set it manually if needed
Missing from a backup that claims to be complete
No longer exists in this version
Created by a newer version and not understood here
Manual review required; it will not be changed
The saved type or value is invalid
Return to the main screen to see the refreshed switches. Restart Bilibili for all hook and logging changes to take effect.
Some settings may have changed, but verification was incomplete. Review the switches.
The file or settings store could not be accessed. No unverified result is being reported as complete.

This file belongs to another product.

Settings changed after the preview was created. Read the file again to build a fresh preview.
The settings store rejected the write. Reopen the module and try again.
The write could not be verified. Reopen the main screen and review the actual switch states.

Some catalog migration steps are unavailable. Only self-describing settings that are still exactly compatible will be restored; all other items remain unchanged.
